reviews._readme: Google rating and count shown with an as-of date (warned by check.py after 90 days). Quotes are word for word; only those with publish: true appear on the site, and those with home: true also appear on the home page. Never add star graphics or Review/aggregateRating schema.

quotes.name: Samantha G.
quotes.text: Liz cut my hair yesterday and I couldn't be happier. She worked patiently with the mess I had and brought me back to life 🥹 will certainly be going back.

quotes.name: Anna M.
quotes.hold: Date given as Aug. 2016, but the review names Cherish, who started at Bellezza in 2023. Confirm the date, then set publish: true.
quotes.text: I always look forward to my visits at  Bellezza!! It's Beautiful inside and out!!  And Cherish is Wonderful!!! I feel so pampered when she takes care of me during my haircut and brow wax!!! Thank You for always making me feel special!!! :)

quotes.name: Barbara G.
quotes.text: Bellezza is my go to place to get a manicure and pedicure.  I always feel welcome and special when I go to my appointments. Madison is a wonderful nail artist and my nails and toes always look very nice.There is a great choice of colors to choose from for your manicure and pedicure.  Everyone at Bellezza is friendly and welcoming.  Highly recommend.

quotes.name: Stephanie L.
quotes.text: The place is very welcoming and clean! Everyone was professional and friendly. Hope is fantastic and I love my nails!!

quotes.name: Tami R.
quotes.text: I had several facials with derma plane by Emma. She is very professional and does a fabulous job. I am always so relaxed and my skin feels wonderful when I leave. 5 STARS 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

quotes.name: Katelynn W.
quotes.permission: on file in signed bridal paperwork
quotes.text: Austyn and the whole team were so amazing to me and my bridal party on my wedding day. They did an amazing job on our hair and makeup. The salon is so clean and beautiful and everyone is so incredibly nice and professional. I honestly cannot say enough about them.
